summary: Session 80.50 P0 verification (backend + frontend). Backend: 15/15 pytest pass (/api/news-markte/market/sparkline/{DAX,SPX,NDX,DJI} = 200 with >=10 points, unsupported symbols = fast 404 <300ms, /api/unsplash-proxy = 200 image/jpeg + 403 allowlist + 422 missing param, patron login + /api/auth/me + /api/admin/assistant-handoffs = 200). Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080): DOMContentLoaded 0.32 s, ZERO requests to supabase.co/functions/v1/stock-history or market-sparklines (P0 fix confirmed), 0 broken images (196 imgs home / 18 article), login patron -> /admin OK, admin handoff inbox (/admin/assistant-handoffs) loads 10 leads, /wissen/sicher-investieren renders clean. HOWEVER: the logged-in dashboard is still Supabase-driven and completely broken (54 supabase.co REST calls, all HTTP 400, red error banner, all values 0,00 EUR), dashboard sparklines never render (only unsupported equity symbols requested -> 404), the new /api/unsplash-proxy has NO frontend consumer (unsplashProxyUrl.js imported nowhere; article images still hotlink images.unsplash.com), and Home.js still calls Supabase credit_offers/savings_offers (2x HTTP 401 on every public page load).

minor.issue: Returns data_source='fallback' with prev_close 47.71 while the dashboard ticker shows DAX 26.512 — synthetic series has an unrelated price scale, so the rendered sparkline shape/level is meaningless for the index.

Backend sets Cache-Control max-age=86400 but the preview ingress rewrites it to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' -> every image request hits the proxy again (no browser caching). Verify on the production domain.

Edge injects Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * together with Allow-Credentials: true (browser would reject credentialed cross-origin); works today because frontend is same-origin. Worth confirming explicit origin list in app CORS config.

ui_bugs.issue: Red banner 'Einige Dashboard-Daten konnten nicht geladen werden' on every load; all KPIs 0,00 EUR. Root cause: ~54 requests to https://vitmvkmjjwabfzndynlj.supabase.co/rest/v1/* return HTTP 400 (Supabase /auth/v1/token?grant_type=password also 400 -> no Supabase session). Same deprecated-Supabase class as the fixed stock-history bug.

ui_bugs.issue: Only unsupported symbols are requested (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, AMZN, GOOGL) -> all 404, column renders '–'. No DAX/SPX/NDX/DJI sparkline request is made on the dashboard at all, so effectively zero sparklines render. Fails silently (good) but the feature is non-functional.

Malformed watchlist symbols cause 7 x 404 per page load: 'BUND 2', '5% 2034', 'APPLE 3', '25% 2029' (plus AAPL/MSFT/NVDA). Looks like a symbol derived from an instrument name by splitting on spaces. Non-blocking (placeholder shown) but pollutes console/network.
Still queries Supabase credit_offers + savings_offers -> 2 x HTTP 401 console errors on every public page load (home, news, article). Section renders via fallback, so cosmetic/noise only.

/admin/inbox (path named in the test request) is not a route and silently redirects to '/' with no 404 page. Real path is /admin/assistant-headoffs -> /admin/assistant-handoffs. Also /partnerbanken silently redirects to '/'.

integration_issues.issue: New /api/unsplash-proxy endpoint is dead code on the frontend: src/lib/unsplashProxyUrl.js has ZERO importers (grep). Article page loads 4 images directly from images.unsplash.com; 0 requests to /api/unsplash-proxy anywhere. Endpoint itself works (200 image/jpeg). Wire the helper into the image components or drop it.

No in-flight de-duplication: each unsupported symbol is requested twice per page load (UNSUPPORTED set is only filled after the response, and the batch fires all requests via Promise.all). Doubles the 404 traffic.

Could not be exercised: the sidebar only lives in PublicNewsLayout (/news/:slug, /news/v/:slug), while the live article route /nachrichten/:slug uses NachrichtenDetailPage without the sidebar, and /news/watchlist is auth-protected (redirects to /login). No DAX/SPX/NDX/DJI sparkline request was observed on any reachable public page.

rca_of_the_issue: The 80.50 fix removed the deprecated Supabase stock-history/market-sparklines edge-function calls (verified: 0 supabase.co function requests, DOMContentLoaded 0.32s) and added a working /api/unsplash-proxy. Two gaps remain from the same root cause family: (a) the authenticated dashboard still talks to Supabase REST directly and every call returns 400 because the Supabase password grant fails (400) — hence 'Seite lädt nicht richtig' persists behind login; (b) the new unsplash proxy helper is never imported, so images continue to hotlink images.unsplash.com (works today, but the production endpoint is unused). Additionally sparkline consumers request symbols outside the backend's _SPARKLINE_SUPPORTED set, generating ~7-12 fast 404s (non-blocking, silent placeholders) and duplicate requests due to missing in-flight dedupe.
